description: This file defines an interface for accessing application environment statistics, specifically providing a property to obtain total memory usage. It is marked as obsolete, indicating it will be removed in favor of a newer interface.

classes.name: IAppEnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: An interface for retrieving application environment statistics, such as memory usage, marked as obsolete.

methods.name: MemoryUsage
methods.description: A nullable property that returns the total memory usage in bytes if available.
